text:
maria: Heads-up — customer asks we add a lightweight preflight for private deploys: check network policy exceptions, NAT traversal, and minimal telemetry opt-in. Wants a clear success KPI before we sign the contract.

saurav: can you paste the exact KPI they gave?

maria: they want 'install-success' == agent+control-plane healthy within 2h, <5% firewall exceptions requiring manual netops, and telemetry payload <1KB/host (opt-in).

kevin: 2h seems tight if ops has to configure BGP peering. Are we expecting them to self-provision BGP or use relay?

maria: customer will try BGP for prod; they want a relay fallback for initial rollout. preference: BGP + optional relay.

julia: for the preflight we should surface: 1) reachable staging IPs, 2) port egress check to our control-plane, 3) cert chain validation, 4) route leak detection.

andrew: +1. propose a simple script for on-prem netops that runs checks and produces a pass/fail report. sample:```
./priv-preflight.sh --control https://control.us.redwood.example --check-ports 443,50051 --bgp-check
```

kevin: also include a short remediation hint for each failure (e.g., "enable egress on port 443 to control, or configure relay on port 443"). Ops teams won't read a wall of text.

maria: agree. another ask from legal: telemetry must be opt-in and provide a manifest of keys we collect. they want a human-readable manifest in the preflight output.

julia: manifest should be tiny. fields: agent_version, os, cpu_count, install_duration, optional error_log_hash. nothing else. we can hash anything sensitive.

andrew: rollout gating idea: require preflight PASS + signed operator ack (checkbox) before we flip from relay->bgp. we should bake that into the onboarding doc and the installer CLI flow.

ops-bot: NOTE: new preflight job created: job/priv-deploy-preflight-1760145000 queued. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/onramp/jobs/1760145000

kevin: good. what about upgrade paths? customer wants minimal downtime for patch upgrades and explicit rollback plan for kernel/driver mismatches.

maria: propose two upgrade lanes: fast (automated, short window, relay fallback) and cautious (manual approval, extended window, health checks). Launch criteria: both lanes documented + test playbooks + 3 customer trial installs without manual netops intervention.

andrew: add a metric: mean time to restore (MTTR) target for patch rollbacks <= 30 minutes for the fast lane.

julia: we need to make sure our console surfaces preflight results and the manifest. also add a 'download report' button for compliance teams.

maria: next steps: sauri (saurav) to draft the preflight script and manifest JSON schema; julia to wire the console UI; kevin to author the remediation snippets and upgrade-lane doc. let's circle in 48h with a thin PoC.

saurav: I can get a PoC script up by EOD tomorrow, will post results here.

kevin: I'll draft remediation snippets and the rollout lanes doc.

julia: will add console mock and a minimal report schema.

maria: thanks — if we can hit the 48h PoC we'll take it to the customer for feedback. :thumbsup:
